final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT b.link_to_event AS ev, e.status AS st, AVG(b.remaining) AS ar, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) / CAST(b.amount AS REAL)) AS ad FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.status), s2 AS (SELECT st, AVG(ar) AS a2, AVG(ad) AS d2 FROM s1 GROUP BY st), s3 AS (SELECT AVG(ar) AS a3 FROM s1) SELECT s2.st, s2.a2, s2.d2, s2.a2 / CAST(s3.a3 AS REAL) FROM s2 JOIN s3 ON s3.a3 IS NOT NULL
